sections.title: Unlock AI Automation for Your Business
sections.body: Codestra builds controlled AI automation that reduces repetitive work, connects approved systems, and helps teams operate more efficiently.

sections.title: What Are AI Automation Agents?
sections.body: AI automation agents perform configured tasks such as answering questions, processing approved data, routing work, and assisting human decisions.

sections.title: Why Use AI Automation Agents?
sections.body: Use automation where it creates clear operational value:
items: Increase efficiency by automating repetitive tasks.
Reduce avoidable manual operating costs.
Provide timely customer support through approved answers.
Scale configured workflows as demand changes.
Use operational analytics to support better decisions.

sections.title: How AI Automation Agents Work
sections.body: Codestra connects agents to approved systems and boundaries:
items: Natural-language processing for configured conversations.
Machine learning where approved data and oversight permit it.
Task automation from data entry to lead routing.
Omnichannel integration across approved platforms.
Operational analytics for monitored decision support.
